items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal articles excluded under 4.3(d), and property in a conveyance away from the insured location is excluded under 4.3(f). This matches reference case 35, where t was 0.
Conveyance-related and journey costs are excluded under 5.2.5 and 7.1.8(d), and there is no insured event at all. This matches reference case 35, where t was 0.
